proposed: in damage_component_events, retag any heal-source component with a NEGATIVE delta as _UNKNOWN_CALLEE_SOURCE, since a heal cannot reduce HP and the delta has absorbed unrendered Sleep Talk callee damage (mechanism confirmed in reports/c52_impossible_heal_component.json)
headline_number: unattributed 476 -> 459, a net -17, with 4 rows divergent -> matched and ZERO matched -> divergent
verdict: REJECTED. The headline is an artifact.
why_it_is_rejected: ALL 48 of the gains land in one family: I6_sleeptalk_callee_union. That family is bucketed candidate-not-finding in the audit -- it is not an evidenced explanation. So the entire net improvement is 48 rows laundered into an unevidenced bucket, paid for by 31 rows that had real family attributions and now have none. Nothing is explained that was not explained before; the number moves and the understanding does not.
this_is_the_same_call_i_made_in_C37: In C37 I declined to reorder the structural rule ahead of I6, worth up to 57 rows off the certification number, on exactly this ground: 'moving rows into it would launder unattributed rows into an unevidenced family and make the metric move without explaining anything.' The retag reaches the same destination by a different route. Having refused the direct version I am not taking the indirect one because it arrived wearing a mechanism.
what_is_still_true: The C52 mechanism is confirmed and unaffected by this rejection: 79 of 79 defective branches are Sleep Talk branches, 52 of 79 render no damage line at all, and the impossible negative heal component is real. The defect is real; this particular repair is the wrong one.

the_alternative_and_its_cost.option: mark the branch LOSSY rather than retagging the component -- an event stream missing a damage line cannot be compared, which is what the existing _SLEEPTALK_LOSSY_MARKER path already expresses
the_alternative_and_its_cost.why_it_is_more_honest: it says 'this branch is unusable' instead of 'this damage is explained by a family that explains nothing'
the_alternative_and_its_cost.its_cost: excluded branches can produce skip_lossy verdicts, which reduces measured boundaries -- and coverage is ALREADY a failing gate at 0.9587 against 0.97. This trade has to be measured, not assumed.

the_real_fix: render the Sleep Talk callee's damage event in the crate. That removes the cause instead of relabelling its symptom, and it is an engine-consumer change rather than a matcher one, so it would change the fingerprint and force era re-derivation.
does_not_reach_a_pass: no code changed; unattributed stays at 476

alternative_measured_coverage_cost.question: C53 rejected the retag and named marking the branch LOSSY as the honest alternative, with an unmeasured coverage cost. This measures that cost.
alternative_measured_coverage_cost.method: over the 476 unattributed rows, counted how many have EVERY branch carrying an impossible heal component -- those boundaries would become skip_lossy and leave the measured set
alternative_measured_coverage_cost.coverage_cost: 15 boundaries out of the 476 unattributed. Against 787,376 measured boundaries that is 0.002%, so the coverage gate at 0.9587 is not materially moved by the loss itself.
alternative_measured_coverage_cost.the_extrapolation_i_am_NOT_making: This is measured over the unattributed set only. The lossy rule would apply to every boundary in a sweep, including the matched majority. C52's control gives the base rate -- 0.8% of attributed rows carry a defective branch against 16.6% of unattributed -- and matched boundaries by definition had a branch that matched, so all-branches-defective should be rarer still. That is a reasoned expectation, not a measurement, and the sweep-wide cost is unknown.
alternative_measured_coverage_cost.what_is_still_unmeasured: The BENEFIT. I measured what the lossy rule costs and not what it clears. Removing a defective branch only helps if another branch then matches, and I have not run that. The decision between lossy-marking and rendering the callee event cannot be made on a cost figure alone, and I am not going to present a half-measured trade as though it were a recommendation.
